name: AI Case Studies
blurb: Published accounts of real AI deployments, indexed from the firms that write them, newest first, each linked to the original.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence at Lowes
studies.summary: Lowe’s Companies operates as a Fortune 100 home improvement retailer, with fiscal year 2025 sales that exceeded $86 billion. The company employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates more than 1,750 stores, 540 branches, and 120 distribution centers across the United States.

studies.title: Spot Robot From Boston Dynamics Deployed at Utah Copper Mine
studies.summary: Spot is being used to automate inspections, optimize operations and improve workforce safety.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence at Caterpillar
studies.summary: Caterpillar ranks as the world’s largest construction equipment manufacturer and also produces off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, and diesel-electric locomotives, headquartered in Irving, Texas.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence at Mayo Clinic
studies.summary: Mayo Clinic is a nonprofit academic medical center headquartered in Rochester, Minnesota, with additional campuses in Arizona and Florida and a regional health system spanning three Upper Midwest states.

studies.title: Pacsun’s Gen Z playbook: Listen, learn, and let go
studies.summary: Brieane Olson, CEO of the US-based clothing retailer, says the secret to the company’s success is community cocreation—which can work in other industries, too.

studies.title: Bayer’s Sai Jasti on driving productivity in R&D with data science and AI
studies.summary: Sai Jasti, Bayer’s senior vice president and head of data science and AI, on how the company is transforming its workflows and embedding AI in research and development to meet ambitious productivity goals.

studies.title: Lion Finance: Competing like a fintech, winning as a bank
studies.summary: Archil Gachechiladze, Lion Finance and Bank of Georgia CEO, describes how focused execution and cultural change have driven the group’s strong financial performance.

studies.title: AI transformations: Views from AMD, Dell, Liquid AI, and Mercedes-Benz
studies.summary: Executives from AMD, Dell, Liquid AI, and Mercedes-Benz discuss how to structure processes with AI in mind and why enterprise-wide transformation is about people, not just technology.

studies.title: How AI-enabled execution became Reckitt’s ‘tenfold game changer’
studies.summary: RGMx helped Reckitt improve pricing, promotions, and assortment. Smart Execution helps those choices land at the point of sale by using AI and data to strengthen product availability and retailer partnerships.

studies.title: Joseph Tsai: Putting customers at the heart of innovation
studies.summary: Joseph Tsai has reshaped Cathay United Bank by balancing innovation with a long-term view that consistently focuses on the customer.

studies.title: Putting innovation—and patients—in focus: A conversation with Astellas Pharma CEO Naoki Okamura
studies.summary: The Tokyo-based biopharmaceutical company is accelerating its pipeline by innovating at the intersection of biology, modality, and disease.
